field.name: num
field.comment: How many pages are listed (0: all of them)

field.name: orderBy
field.comment: display_asc: the order of the sitemap; display_desc: the reverse order; chrono_asc: by date, oldest first; chrono_desc: by date, most recent first; alpha_asc: by name; alpha_desc: by name, reversed; modified_desc: most recently changed first; random

field.name: cParentID
field.comment: The ID of the page whose children are listed (0: the whole site): it's used only when cThis and cThisParent are both false

field.name: cThis
field.comment: true: the children of the page holding the block are listed; false: cThisParent decides

field.name: cThisParent
field.comment: true: the children of the parent of the page holding the block are listed; false: cParentID decides

field.name: useButtonForLink
field.comment: true: every listed page is linked with a button; false: its name is the link

field.name: buttonLinkText
field.comment: The text of the button (used if useButtonForLink is true)

field.name: pageListTitle
field.comment: The text displayed above the list

field.name: filterByRelated
field.comment: true: only the pages sharing a topic with the page holding the block are listed; false: they are not filtered this way

field.name: filterByCustomTopic
field.comment: true: only the pages assigned to the customTopicTreeNodeID topic are listed; false: they are not filtered this way

field.name: filterDateOption
field.comment: all: every page is listed; now: only the ones published today; past: the ones published in the last filterDateDays days; future: the ones to be published in the next filterDateDays days; between: the ones published from filterDateStart to filterDateEnd

field.name: filterDateDays
field.comment: How many days back or ahead the pages can be published in, 0 for no limit (used if filterDateOption is past or future)

field.name: filterDateStart
field.comment: The first day the pages can be published in, as YYYY-MM-DD (used if filterDateOption is between)

field.name: filterDateEnd
field.comment: The last day the pages can be published in, as YYYY-MM-DD (used if filterDateOption is between)

field.name: relatedTopicAttributeKeyHandle
field.comment: The handle of the topics attribute holding the topics to be shared (used if filterByRelated is true)

field.name: customTopicAttributeKeyHandle
field.comment: The handle of the topics attribute of the pages holding the topic (used if filterByCustomTopic is true)

field.name: customTopicTreeNodeID
field.comment: The ID of the topic the listed pages must be assigned to (0: none): when it doesn't belong to the customTopicAttributeKeyHandle attribute the filter is turned off

field.name: includeName
field.comment: true: the name of every listed page is displayed; false: it's left out

field.name: includeDescription
field.comment: true: the description of every listed page is displayed; false: it's left out

field.name: includeDate
field.comment: true: the date every listed page was published in is displayed; false: it's left out

field.name: includeAllDescendents
field.comment: true: the pages at any depth below the chosen page are listed; false: only its children are listed

field.name: paginate
field.comment: true: the pages are split in pages of num items; false: only the first num pages are listed

field.name: excludeCanonicalPaging
field.comment: true: the canonical URL of the page leaves the paging out; false: it keeps it

field.name: displayAliases
field.comment: true: the aliases of the pages are listed too; false: they are left out

field.name: displaySystemPages
field.comment: true: the pages of the system are listed too; false: they are left out

field.name: ignorePermissions
field.comment: true: the pages that the visitor is not allowed to view are listed too; false: they are left out

field.name: enableExternalFiltering
field.comment: true: the query string of the page filters the listed pages too; false: it's ignored

field.name: excludeCurrentPage
field.comment: true: the page holding the block is left out of the list; false: it's listed like the other ones

field.name: ptID
field.comment: The ID of the page type that the listed pages must have (0 or NULL: any page type)

field.name: pfID
field.comment: The ID of the RSS feed publishing the listed pages (0 or NULL: none)

field.name: truncateSummaries
field.comment: true: the descriptions are cut to truncateChars characters; false or NULL: they are displayed whole

field.name: displayFeaturedOnly
field.comment: true: only the pages whose is_featured attribute is set are listed; false or NULL: all of them are listed

field.name: noResultsMessage
field.comment: The text displayed when no page is listed

field.name: displayThumbnail
field.comment: true: the thumbnail of every listed page is displayed; false or NULL: it's left out

field.name: truncateChars
field.comment: How many characters the descriptions are cut to (used if truncateSummaries is true)

field.name: titleFormat
field.comment: The HTML element wrapping the text displayed above the list: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 or p
